title: 2785. Sort Vowels in a String

examples.explanation: 'E', 'O', and 'e' are the vowels in s; 'l', 't', 'c', and 'd' are all consonants. The vowels are sorted according to their ASCII values, and the consonants remain in the same places.
There are no vowels in s (all characters in s are consonants), so we return "lYmpH".
